payments.order-not-found: The order to pay was not found
payments.card-not-available: Card payments are not offered by this shop.
payments.order-not-payable: This order cannot be paid in its current status.
payments.not-confirmable: This payment is not awaiting confirmation.
payments.intent-conflict: A payment for this order is already open. Reload and try again.
payments.declined: The payment was declined by the card issuer.
payments.requires_confirmation: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed.
payments.requires_action: Your bank needs to confirm this payment — follow the prompt to finish.
payments.processing: The payment is going through — we will email you as soon as it settles.
payments.confirm-success: Payment received — the order is paid.
payments.not-refundable: This payment cannot be refunded — no money arrived, or it has already been returned.
payments.in-flight: A card payment is already in progress for this order — wait for it to resolve before recording money by hand.
payments.received-at-future: The date the money arrived cannot be in the future.
payments.offline-recorded: Payment recorded — the order is paid.
payments.webhook-not-configured: This shop takes no card payments.
payments.webhook-unverified: That delivery could not be verified.
payments.refund-exceeds-remaining: That is more than is left to refund on this payment.
payments.refund-currency-mismatch: The refund's currency is not the payment's currency.
payments.refund-invalid-amount: That is not a valid amount in the payment's currency.

failure-reason.expired_or_canceled_card: The card is expired or cancelled.
failure-reason.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was reported lost or stolen.
failure-reason.provider_unavailable: The provider could not be reached.
failure-reason.unknown: The provider gave no usable reason.

email-transfer.subject: Complete your order by bank transfer
email-transfer.body: Your order is reserved. Send the transfer below to complete it — include the reference so we can match your payment.

email-transfer-expired.subject: Your order was cancelled — no transfer received
email-transfer-expired.body: We didn't receive your bank transfer in time, so this order has been cancelled and its items released.

email-received.subject: Payment received
email-received.body: We've received your payment — your order is now being prepared.

email-refunded.subject: Your refund has been issued
email-refunded.body: We have refunded {{amount}} for your order {{order}}.
email-refunded.detail-full: That is everything you paid for this order.
email-refunded.detail-partial: That is part of what you paid; the rest of the payment stays with the order. How long it takes to show up depends on your bank or card issuer.
